Every summer, New York City transforms nearly 20 miles of streets across all five boroughs into a vibrant playground for pedestrians, runners, cyclists, skaters, and families. **Summer Streets 2025** continues that tradition, returning for five Saturdays: **July 26, August 2, 9, 16, and 23** from **7 AM to 3 PM** — with no cars, no traffic, and no entry fees.

During Summer Streets, iconic thoroughfares like **Park Avenue**, **Lafayette Street**, and **Centre Street** go fully car-free, opening up for art installations, fitness classes, music performances, and free activities for people of all ages.
Water stops and shaded rest areas help you stay cool while you ride or stroll.
The main Manhattan route stretches from **109th Street in Harlem** to the **Brooklyn Bridge**, but Summer Streets now reaches far beyond Manhattan.
Since expanding in 2023, the event includes boroughs like **Queens**, **Staten Island**, **Brooklyn**, and **The Bronx**, creating a truly citywide celebration.
Unlimited Biking is once again an **official partner** of NYC Summer Streets, offering **free one-hour bike rentals** at key locations throughout the city.
It’s the easiest way to join the ride if you don’t own a bike or are visiting the city.
These locations are perfect starting points to hop on a bike and explore the best of what Summer Streets has to offer.
*   **Promotes Active Living**: A safe, welcoming space for biking, skating, running, or simply walking — it’s open to all.
*   **Supports Sustainable Cities**: Encourages greener transportation by removing cars and celebrating people-powered mobility.
*   **Celebrates Community & Culture**: Music, dance, art, and fitness classes bring people together, supported by NYC DOT and local partners.
*   **Built on Tradition**: Since 2008, Summer Streets has welcomed hundreds of thousands every year.
Now it’s bigger and better than ever.
**Summer Streets NYC 2025** is your chance to experience the city in a way you can’t the rest of the year — completely car-free.
Whether you’re riding solo, with family, or alongside thousands of fellow New Yorkers, it’s an experience that brings the city to life.
With Unlimited Biking’s free one-hour rentals and discounted longer-term options, you don’t need your own gear to enjoy the ride.
Just register, show up, and get rolling.
